messages:
Mina: Follow-up from the KV shard postmortem. We saw a recurring pattern: nightly batch spikes + occasional small deploys -> transient shard evictions. Need concrete owners and tests: regression promptset to catch the fingerprint, a reproducible load job with TTL override, and a controlled chaos drill that exercises fallback routing and warm-cache behavior.

Josh: Agree. Break into lanes: (1) CI guard = promptset + fingerprint, (2) verification = load job + TTL override, (3) validation = tabletop + live drill with rollback playbook.

Carla: I can own the promptset. Plan: 6 seeds pulled from traces (cold-start user, batch-aligned burst, many short requests, long-context, streaming-early-close, retry-heavy). Will tag each with eviction_fingerprint metadata. ETA: PR by Thu.

Priya: I'll help with expected-output curation and add a small eval harness that runs locally. Also suggest adding a tiny synthetic prompt that reliably hits the cold-path.

Sam: I'll take the load harness. k6 scenario: ramp 60->1600 rps over 8m with an optional stage that posts TTL overrides via ops API. Will include preflight checks, a kill-switch, and traffic cap. Need the exact request mix from traces to shape payloads. @Josh can you attach?

Josh: Trace window and ops snapshots: https://redwood.internal/trace/EVT-2026-kv-evict and TICKET-4821. Noted batch job at ~02:30 UTC and a couple small deploys coincidentally.

Mina: Promptset acceptance criteria: CI should fail if p99 increases >12% OR token generation cost >1.8x vs baseline. Store prompts under evals/incidents/kv-evictions/ and run nightly. The fingerprint metadata must link back to postmortem notes.

Carla: Will open PR with prompts, expected outputs, and a README for triage steps. I will also add streaming vs non-stream variants since both paths regressed.

Sam: TTL override example I'll include in the playbook (gated behind feature flag and staging rehearsal):
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://ops-api.internal/shards/override-ttl -d '{"shard_group":7,"ttl_seconds":20}'
Will make the override optional in k6 and ensure the job aborts if token cost exceeds 2.5x baseline.

ops-bot: Created TICKET-6001 "kv-evict: promptset + load + drill" assigned Carla, Sam, Priya. Due 2026-06-11.

QA-bot: Nightly eval added: evals/incidents/kv-evictions runs 03:00 UTC and posts failures to #eng-platform; failures open a regression incident candidate in the evals dashboard.

Josh: Proposed cadence: tabletop Tuesday (scenario walkthrough), live drill Wednesday (controlled). Tabletop deliverables: scenario doc, rollback steps, observability asserts (cache miss %, regen token cost, request error rate) and contact matrix. Live drill only after staging rehearsal.

Carla: I'll draft the scenario doc + checklist by Monday and include prechecks and rollback commands.

Priya: I'll coordinate with Product on whether promptset failures should gate rollouts or just trigger investigation. Will follow up once PR lands.

Sam: I'll rehearse the k6+TTL flow in staging and publish the safe-playbook with a one-command kill-switch. Acceptance for load job: p95/p99 within baseline thresholds under synthetic spike and token cost <2x. I'll publish numeric thresholds after baseline run.

Josh: I'll add monitoring alerts: sustained cache-miss rate >4% for 3m -> page SRE; create a dashboard with eviction_fingerprint and batch-job overlay. I'll also attach trace snippets for replay.

Mina: Owners recap and deadlines: Carla = promptset PR (sub-ticket) by Thu, Priya = expected outputs + eval harness by Thu, Sam = k6 + TTL stage + playbook by next Tue, Josh = monitoring + traces by Mon. Tabletop Tue, live drill Wed next sprint. I'll own the post-drill writeup and update the postmortem with links to PRs and lessons learned.

Carla: Will ping Product (Priya) and Solutions in the PR for rollout sign-off.

Mina: Thanks. Keeping thread open until TICKET-6001 is In Progress. Ping here if blockers or scope creep.
